```{r setup}
library(deSolve)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

$$
\begin{align*}
\frac{dH_i}{dt} &= r_iH_i(1-\frac{H_i}{K_i})- 
(1-\psi_i\min ( 1,\frac{H_i}{Ki}) ) \frac{a_i\alpha_i}{1+a_ih\alpha_i} 
- \sum_j(\delta_{j,i}H_j)  \\
\frac{dP}{dt} 
  &= r_PP(1-\frac{P}{K_p})+ 
  \sum_i( \beta_i
  \frac{a_i\alpha_i}{1+a_ih\alpha_i} )
  - \sum_i(\delta_{i,P}H_i)\\
\frac{d\alpha_i}{dt} &=  c_i\gamma P - \min(0,\frac{\frac{dP}{dt}}{P})\alpha_i\\
\text{Uniform: } &c_i = \frac{1}n  \\
\text{Body Mass: } &c_i = \frac{H_i}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} H_j} \\
\\ \text{
PC: } &c_i =  \frac{  \beta_i\frac{a_i(\alpha_i + c_i\gamma P)}
             {1+a_ih_i(\alpha_i + c_i\gamma P)} - \beta_i\frac{a_i\alpha_i}{1+a_ih_i\alpha_i}
 }{\sum_j^n \beta_j\frac{a_j(\alpha_j + c_j\gamma P)}{1+a_jh_j(\alpha_j + c_j\gamma P} - \beta_j\frac{a_j\alpha_j}{1+a_jh_j\alpha_j}} 
\end{align*}
$$

```{r mod}

model <- function(time, state, new_h, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
  
    #forb
    d_HF <-  r_HF*HF*(1-(HF/K_HF)) - 
      ((1-psi_F*(HF/K_HF)) * (a_F*alpha_F)/(1+a_F*h_F*alpha_F)) -
      delta_LF*HF*HL - delta_GF*HG*HF 
    
    
    
    #legume
    d_HL <-  r_HL*HL*(1-(HL/K_HL)) -
      ((1-psi_L*(HL/K_HL)) * (a_L*alpha_L)/(1+a_L*h_L*alpha_L)) -
      delta_FL*HF*HL -  delta_GL*HG*HL 
    
    #grass
    d_HG <-  r_HG*HG*(1-(HG/K_HG)) -
      ((1-psi_G*(HG/K_HG)) * (a_G*alpha_G)/(1+a_G*h_G*alpha_G)) -
      delta_FG*HF*HG - delta_LG*HG*HL
    
    #parasite
    d_P <-  r_P*P*(1- (P/K_P))  + 
      betaF*((a_F*alpha_F^2)/(1+a_F*h_F*alpha_F)) + 
      betaL*((a_L*alpha_L)/(1+a_L*h_L*alpha_L)) +
      betaG*((a_G*alpha_G)/(1+a_G*h_G*alpha_G)) -
      (delta_FP*HF + delta_GP*HG + delta_LP*HL)
    
    #will give new alpha (haustoria) depending on value of "new_h"
    alpha_val <- switch(
      new_h,
      
      "BM" = {
        out <- c(HF, HL, HG)/sum(HF,HL,HG, na.rm = T)
        ifelse(is.na(out), 0, out)
      }
      , #proportion of available biomass 
      
      "Unif" = {
        out <- c(1/3,1/3,1/3)
        out
      },
      
      "PC" = { #parasite choice, parasite gives 80% new haustoria to the host the gives it the best return on investment 
        
        #RIGHT NOW DOSE NOT TAKE INTO ACCOUNT HOST MORTALITY FROM ADITIONAL HAUSTORIA  
        vec <- c(
          
          ifelse(HF>0,
                 
                betaF* ( (a_F*(alpha_F+gamma*P))/(1+a_F*h_F*(alpha_F+gamma*P)) - 
                    (a_F*alpha_F)/(1+a_F*h_F*alpha_F)), 0),
          
          
          ifelse(HL>0, 
                 betaL* ((a_L*(alpha_L+gamma*P))/(1+a_L*h_L*(alpha_L+gamma*P)) -
                    (a_L*alpha_L)/(1+a_L*h_L*alpha_L)) , 0 ),
          
          
          ifelse(HG>0,   
                 
                 betaG* ((a_G*(alpha_G+gamma*P))/(1+a_G*h_G*(alpha_G+gamma*P)) - 
                    (a_G*alpha_G)/(1+a_G*h_G*alpha_G)), 0)
        )
        
        out <- vec/sum(vec)
        out
      }
    ) 
    
    
    d_alpha_F <- gamma*alpha_val[1]*P 

    d_alpha_L <- gamma*alpha_val[2]*P 

    d_alpha_G <- gamma*alpha_val[3]*P 
  
    
    #updating y
    
    return(list(c(
      d_HF ,
      d_HL ,
      d_HG ,
      d_P ,
      
      d_alpha_F ,
      d_alpha_L ,
      d_alpha_G
    )))

  })
}

```

```{r ploting fun }

plotting <- function(results, lab, time_steps){
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    time = time_steps,
    results
  )
  
  long <- pivot_longer(
    plot_df,
    cols = c(HF, HL, HG, P),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  )
  
  plot <- ggplot(long,
                 aes(x = time, y = Value, colour = Variable)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Host and Parasite - ", lab),
      x = "Time",
      y = "Biomass"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      HF = "#FF8000",
      HL = "#2C85B2",
      HG = "#6B990F",
      P  = "red"
    ))
  
  
  alpha_long <- pivot_longer(
    plot_df,
    cols = c(alpha_F, alpha_L, alpha_G),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  )
  
  alpha_plot <- ggplot(alpha_long,
                       aes(x = time, y = Value, colour = Variable)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = "Haustoria ",
      x = "Time",
      y = "#"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      alpha_F = "#FFBF80",
      alpha_L = "#7EC3E5",
      alpha_G = "#A3CC51"
    ))
  
  plot / alpha_plot
  
}

```

```{r params}

#inital population
init_P_HD <- c(HF = 50,  HL =50, HG = 50, P = 10, 
               alpha_F = 0, alpha_L =0, alpha_G =0) 

#timeing
time_steps <- seq(0, 100, by = 1) 

#parameters
params <- params <- c(
  r_HF = 0.40, K_HF = 50, 
  r_HL = 0.5, K_HL = 50, 
  r_HG = 0.6, K_HG = 65, 
  
  #comp
  delta_LF = 0.0008,
  delta_FL = 0.0006,
  
  delta_GF = 0.0004,
  delta_GL = 0.0004,
  
  delta_FG = 0.0009,
  delta_LG = 0.0008,
  
  delta_FP = 0.0009,
  delta_LP = 0.0008,
  delta_GP = 0.0009,

  
  #parasite resistance
  
  psi_F = 0.5,
  psi_L = 0.4,
  psi_G = 0.2,
  

  #parasite stuff 
  betaG = 0.1,
  betaF = 0.2,
  betaL = 0.3,
  r_P = 0.3,
  K_P = 10,
  gamma = 1,
  l_P = 0.06,
  
  #handling time
  h_F = 0.5,
  h_G = 0.5,
  h_L = 0.5,
  
  
  a_F = 0.005,
  a_G = 0.09,
  a_L = 0.005
  
)


```

```{r results}
results_Unif <- ode(y = init_P_HD, 
               times = time_steps, 
               func = model, 
               new_h = "Unif",
               parms = params)

plotting(results_Unif, "Unif", time_steps)


results_BM <- ode(y = init_P_HD, 
              times = time_steps, 
              func = model, 
              new_h = "BM",
              parms = params)

plotting(results_BM, "BM", time_steps)

results_PC<- ode(y = init_P_HD, 
              times = time_steps, 
              func = model, 
              new_h = "PC",
              parms = params)

plotting(results_PC, "PC", 1:length((results_PC)[,1]))

```
